name: Buddhist Monuments in the Horyu-ji Area
description: In Ikaruga, Nara Prefecture, the Hōryū-ji area holds about 48 Buddhist buildings, including the temples of Hōryū-ji and Hokki-ji. Some date from the late 7th or early 8th century, so they rank among the oldest wooden buildings still standing anywhere. Walking through the temple grounds, you see how Chinese temple design was reshaped in Japan just as Buddhism arrived.
